boards.title: DFRobot UNIHIKER K10 – ESP32-S3 2.8" AI coding board with camera, mic, speaker
spec_rows: UNIHIKER K10 is an ESP32-S3-based AI coding board for STEM learning and maker projects. A 2.8-inch color display, 2MP camera, microphone, speaker, RGB lights and onboard sensors.
notes: Only the facts stated in the product introduction are listed; resolution / memory are not taken from third-party sources.
